description: This file is the main activity for an Android wearable app called SpeedTracker. It manages location updates, displays current speed and speed limit, handles permissions, and communicates with other components via GoogleApiClient and Data Layer API. It provides a user interface for setting speed limits and visual indicators for GPS status and speed relative to the limit.

classes.name: WearableMainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the SpeedTracker wearable app, managing location updates, UI, permissions, and data communication.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, permissions, and GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes location updates and disconnects GoogleApiClient when the activity pauses.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reconnects GoogleApiClient when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onSpeedLimitClick
methods.description: Starts SpeedPickerActivity for user to select a speed limit.

methods.name: onGpsPermissionClick
methods.description: Requests location permission if not already granted.

methods.name: updateActivityViewsBasedOnLocationPermissions
methods.description: Updates UI based on whether location permission is granted and GPS signal status.

methods.name: updateSpeedInViews
methods.description: Updates speed and limit text views and color based on current speed.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Called when GoogleApiClient connects; requests location updates.

methods.name: requestLocation
methods.description: Requests high-accuracy location updates via LocationServices API.

methods.name: onLocationChanged
methods.description: Updates current speed, UI, and adds location data to storage on location update.

methods.name: addLocationEntry
methods.description: Creates a data entry with location info and sends it via Data Layer API.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from SpeedPickerActivity and updates speed limit settings.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles user's response to location permission request.

methods.name: hasGps
methods.description: Checks if device supports GPS hardware feature.
